business_summary: Eaton Vance California Municipal Income Trust is a close ended fixed income mutual fund launched and managed by Eaton Vance Management. It invests in the fixed income markets. The fund invests primarily in debt securities issued by education, hospital, housing, insured-education, insured-electric utilities, insured-hospital, insured-transportation, insured-water and sewer, transportation, and other sectors. Eaton Vance California Municipal Income Trust was formed in 1999 and is domiciled in United States.
business_summary_ko: Eaton Vance California Municipal Income Trust는 Eaton Vance Management가 시작하고 관리하는 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 주로 교육, 병원, 주택, 보험 교육, 전기 보험, 병원 보험, 교통 보험, 상하수도 보험, 교통 및 기타 부문에서 발행한 채무 증권에 투자합니다. Eaton Vance California Municipal Income Trust는 1999년에 설립되었으며 미국에 주소를 두고 있습니다.
